picks.name: Anthony Naples
picks.source_note: Already in your library (previously seeded for the Sept 24 "BBT / Seven" single) -- a different, full-length release on his own ANS label. Dry research day; exact Bandcamp album-page slug unconfirmable via search, so the purchase link points to his confirmed-live Bandcamp root.
picks.bio: "In Studio Magic" (ANS Records) is Naples' seventh full-length -- ten tracks shaped between 2024 and 2025, recorded, produced, and mixed entirely by himself, leaning further into live instrumentation and studio texture than his club-facing singles.
picks.why_listen: A more patient, textural side of a producer usually filed under tight house tracks -- good material for a late-set or warm-up stretch where atmosphere matters more than punch.
